gen-dafont-bloody-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall lowercase bodies that make it look bolder than it is, with terminals flaring outward. Mozilla Text is the one to size up if the page needs more presence; Bloody can stay as it is.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans draws curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths, steady as if inked with a technical pen. Bloody does best at commanding attention with its big round bowls, while Nata Sans does best at keeping the text line quiet and tidy.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its capitals and lowercase almost level, with open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined, under a heavy display heading. Shrink Bloody and it loses its bite.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase in every line. Bloody's big round bowls shout above it, while the sans-serif body keeps its s wide open and approachable beneath.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads cleanly, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and its c wide open. And Bloody's big round bowls give the pair its bite, a commanding display face over a sans-serif that never fights back.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with lowercase c, s and z standing tall and full. Noto Sans Adlam is built for steady reading, whereas Bloody does its best work being loud with those big round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody a commanding, bloody look that is hard to ignore. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs follows in a plain sans, its outward-pointing terminals and tall x-height keeping the text modern and quiet beneath the shouting.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls give it a commanding, bloody swagger straight away. And Noto Sans Arabic, a sans-serif with a pronounced x-height and wide openings, does the quiet work of being read.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian reads warmly, with lowercase c, s and z standing tall and full and round letters opening wide. Over a longer stretch, that sans stays inviting.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Those big round lowercase bowls make Bloody feel commanding and a little bloody from the first glance. Noto Sans Avestan, a plain sans with a pronounced x-height and curve tips that never touch, is the pair's strongest card for clarity.
